title: Sightmap config v1
description: A `.sightmap/config.yaml` file. Optional in any project; pins spec version. The file is mostly a marker that the project uses sightmap (analogous to `.prettierrc`'s presence). Most projects can omit it entirely. Future versions may add fields; the schema is additive. See https://github.com/sightmap/sightmap/blob/main/spec/v1/canonical-format.md for the canonical format and authoring-side diagnostic codes.

version.description: Must be 1 for files that conform to this version of the spec.
